description:
OUTREACH EVENT  - The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Caribbean District is planning to procure services for surveying and mapping to support various civil works projects. These projects may include, but are not limited to, topographic surveys, property/boundary surveys, geodetic control surveys, construction surveys, and inland hydrographic surveys. The scope of work will cover projects within the geographic boundaries of the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico and the United States Virgin Islands.
